mapper.sql: id, plan_id, account_id, tutorial_id, chapter_id, target_type, target_id, task_date, sequence_no, status, generation_version, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sr_study_task (plan_id, account_id, tutorial_id, chapter_id, target_type, target_id, task_date, sequence_no, status, generation_version) VALUES (#{planId}, #{accountId}, #{tutorialId}, #{chapterId}, 'CHAPTER', #{chapterId}, #{taskDate}, #{sequenceNo}, 'TODO', #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_study_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY task_date, sequence_no LIMIT 1000
SELECT FROM sr_study_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY task_date, sequence_no
SELECT FROM sr_study_task WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND task_date <= #{today} AND status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'OVERDUE') ORDER BY task_date, sequence_no LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_study_task SET status = 'OVERDUE' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND task_date < #{today} AND status = 'TODO'
UPDATE sr_study_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sr_study_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status <> 'COMPLETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_study_task SET status = 'SKIPPED' WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'OVERDUE')
